title.narrative: Towards TB/HIV Epidemic Control in Malawi: Bringing Innovations to Scale - Malawi (01-Jan-2016-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Malawi, TB/HIV, Ministry of Health of the Republic of Malawi (MOH)This program has the following goals: Reduce HIV-related morbidity and mortality. Reduce morbidity and mortality from tuberculosis. Reduce the number of new infections towards elimination of HIV transmission by 2030. The objectives of this program are: 90% of diagnosed PLHIV are on ART. 90% of PLHIV know their status. 90% of PLHIV on ART are virally suppressed. Increase case finding of RR/MDR TB to 60%. Increase TB case notification to 191/100000. Increase Treatment success of bacteriolgically confirmed TB case to 88%. Reduce the number of new HIV infections among key and vulnerable populations
